Respondent :- State of U.P. and Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,A.K. Misra,Shiv Pratap Singh Hon'ble Salil Kumar Rai,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
Present petition has been filed challenging the order dated 11/15 May, 2007 passed by the Joint Secretary, Allahabad Development Authority rejecting the representation of the petitioners for regularizing the plot namely plot no. 49 area 194 square yard in their favour after taking development charges from the petitioners.

A reading of order indicates that the plot was acquired by the State Government and was subsequently allotted to the Allahabad Development Authority for further allotment to the applicants for construction of residential house.
The Allahabad Development Authority has rejected the representation of the petitioners on the ground that the petitioners have right to apply for allotment and seek allotment in accordance with law.

sentences.text: We do not find any error or illegality in the order passed by the Joint Secretary, Allahabad Development Authority.

A query was put to the counsel for the petitioners to show statutory provision under which the Allahabad Development Authority is empowered to regularise the plots acquired under the Land Acquisition Act in favour of the person in occupation of the same but no statutory provision or any judicial precedent was produced before this Court.

The counsel for the petitioners prays that the matter be disposed of with the direction that the case of the petitioner be considered under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the 'Act',
2013).
We are unable to agree with the prayer of the counsel for the petitioners inasmuch as the present case is not covered under Section 24 of the Act, 2013 as the acquisition were made much before 1987.
In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed.
Order Date :- 23.3.2023 A.Kr.
